title: TodoDataGeneratorTool
description: Custom MCP tool schema for generating deterministic TodoMVC datasets, computing expected state counters, and generating edge-case payloads.

count.description: Total number of todo items to generate

completedRatio.description: Fraction of items that should be marked completed (0.0 to 1.0)

includeEdgeCases.description: Whether to inject edge cases (special characters, unicode, long strings)

prefix.description: Prefix text for generated todo titles
